Whether you’re getting a jump on holiday shopping or looking to revamp some of your own cookware and appliances before hosting, right now is the perfect time to save on kitchen finds. And Our Place is a seriously good brand to shop for that — especially because Our Place is already running Black Friday deals.

Through the end of November, you can score as much as 45% off cookware sets, the beloved Wonder Oven Pro, bakeware, and so much more. And the deals aren’t limited to the brand’s website. You can find some Our Place deals on Amazon, too.

I’m a big fan of Our Place, and I’ve tried 20 different products from the beautiful and versatile cookware and appliance brand. These are the eight Our Place deals I recommend scooping up during the brand’s Black Friday sale.

If you’re only going to buy one item from Our Place, let it be the Wonder Oven Pro. I use this air fryer toaster oven every single day to toast, bake, roast, air fry, and so much more. It can also broil, reheat, proof, and dehydrate. Its sleek touchscreen and cute chime to let you know your food is done are big selling points for me, as well as how evenly it cooks my food. It comes in five different colors, and you can save $64 on it right now.

As the shopping writer at The Kitchn, I test a lot of nonstick egg pans. This is one I routinely come back to in between testing. This 8.5-inch pan has a titanium nonstick cooking surface that’s super-durable and won’t chip, unlike some other brands. Plus, the Titanium Mini Always Pan Pro can handle temps as high as 1000°F (seriously!). It can also handle metal utensils and is dishwasher safe. It’s on sale for just $129 now.

The brand’s iconic (and viral!) Always Pan is also on sale for Black Friday. Usually $135, the 10.5-inch pan is now just $95. The Always Pan features a ceramic nonstick coating that is free from forever chemicals like PTFE, PFAS, and PFOA, as well as lead, and is oven-safe up to 450°F. It comes in five stunning colors, and includes a steamer basket and a beechwood spatula that can rest right on the pan’s long handle.

It’s always helpful to have a good sheet pan around, especially during the holidays when my really get put to work. Right now, Our Place’s Griddle Pan is on sale for $79 instead of the usual $119 — and let me tell you, it’s worth every penny.

I love the handles, slick nonstick surface, and pretty selection of colors (there are five to choose from, although three won’t ship till December). It’s deep, compared to other sheet pans I’ve used, and can also double as a griddle. That’s right: Just set it across two burners on your stove and you’re setup for fluffy pancakes, juicy smash burgers, and so much more.
5. Ceramic Nonstick Dual Handle Always Pan

Please meet my new favorite pan from Our Place: the Ceramic Nonstick Dual Handle Always Pan. This is one of the newest additions to the brand’s range, having debuted earlier this fall. I’ve been using this pan for a couple months now, and it’s earned a permanent spot in my kitchen because of its wide, shallow nonstick cooking surface that’s perfect for browning ground beef and sausage, searing shrimp, and making one-skillet dinners. It comes in five colors and has a clear lid that makes it easy to keep an eye on whatever I’m cooking.

I’ve tried all three of Our Place’s Wonder Ovens, and while I absolutely love the Wonder Oven Pro, the original Wonder Oven is phenomenal if you (or the person you’re shopping for) has limited counter space and wants a more affordable option. The OG Wonder Oven has six functions: toast, air fry, reheat, roast, bake, and broil. Plus, it comes in four different colors for just $149 right now.

You can score Our Place’s Perfect Pot for just $99, which is a serious steal — it typically sells for $149. This 6.5-quart pot is nice and roomy and surprisingly lightweight. Plus, it comes in five color options, is oven-safe up to 450°F, and features a nonstick surface for easy cleaning. One other cool feature? One side of the lid has slits so you can drain water from pasta or boiled potatoes without having to dirty a colander. So nice!

I didn’t realize how much I would love having a rice cooker until using this one. It fits nicely on my counter and in my pantry (where I store it when not in use), comes in five colors, and has six different functions: white rice, warm, oatmeal, brown rice, quick cook, and custom. I really only use this rice cooker for rice, and it comes out nice and fluffy. I also love that once the rice is done cooking, it starts counting up and keeping the rice warm, so I can easily track how long it’s sitting. It’s become such a nice addition to my kitchen, and right now it’s on sale for just $115.

I’ve been a journalist for nearly a decade and have tested hundreds of products for the kitchen, home, and beyond since 2022. I only write about the cookware, appliances, and ingredients that truly impress me or come highly recommended from trusted experts. The recommendations above aren’t paid endorsements; they are editorially vetted products from our team.
